description: List the landscape design styles Yarda can design in. Pass a style's name (or id) as the `style` of design_yard. All listed styles are available within the account's remaining shared no-card Pro-design allowance for homeowners and professionals. Call get_account for actual remaining access; this catalog does not grant credits or a new allowance. Do not infer a payment requirement from style choice or automatically open checkout. No official style preview images are supplied. Use the text descriptions; do not fetch third-party images unless the user requests them. If requested, label such images as illustrative references, not Yarda designs.
name: list_styles
title: List Styles
